name: Deadline-urgency video (two-line sale-ends skit, 'don't say I didn't warn you', hands-only deal clip)

shots.visual: Two friends on a sofa, one scrolling
Hands-only clip: picking 7 pieces into a box, big deadline text
Offer card with the real end time and timezone

prompts.prompt: Big date/time text (120px, high contrast), 2-3 cuts, end on the offer; make a version for each of the last 3 days ("2 days left", "tomorrow", "today").
Primary text: "Ends [day] at midnight [timezone]. After that it's back to full price."

paid_ads.title: Seora Skincare: Buy 1 Get 1 FREE ✨
paid_ads.what: A 16 s loop: hands hold two tubes under a "BUY 1 GET 1 FREE · 4 HOURS LEFT" banner while the VO says "This is going to be the last day… they end the sale at midnight."
paid_ads.how: Film the product in hand for 10-15 s with a big banner (offer + hours left) and a 2-sentence VO (last day, how the discount applies at checkout).

paid_ads.how: Have a staff member speak to camera while unboxing: "I saw what people are paying right now. Go."

qa_checklist: Hook lands in the first 1.5 s (video) or is readable at thumbnail size (static / slide 1).
Removal test: delete the product from the script. If it still makes sense, rewrite so the product is the payoff.
Matches the reference structure (same beat order and length band) before any creative twist.
Uses only real product imagery for the product; AI is for backgrounds, characters or b-roll, and is disclosed where required.
Every claim is on the brand's approved-claims list (PDP); no invented stats, reviews, doctors or customers.
Captions burned in and inside the safe zone; sound-off still understandable.
One clear CTA that matches the landing page offer.
Three hook variants delivered for the same body (test hooks, not whole new ads).
Avoid: Real deadlines only; turn the ads off when the sale ends.
Avoid: Don't run "last day" creative for more than one day.
inputs: BRAND (name, product, price, offer, audience, proof points, banned claims)
ASSETS (real product photos/video, logo, fonts, colors)
outputs: brands/<brand-slug>.md with 3 concepts in the output schema below
per concept: script/slide copy, shot list, on-screen text, caption, CTA, 3 hook variants, prompts used
